expectedLearning: Which registry is the smallest truthful authority for concrete loadable catalogue identity.
Which existing adapters can host assets without iframe or renderer changes, and where hostability gaps actually lie.
Whether the approved solve-x shell remains simple under one structurally different caller after human approval.
Which human dispositions and high-information seams should determine the canonical port queue.
